external_motivation: ScientistTwo (Nam et al., 2026, arXiv:2609.19644) runs its own integrity audits before release (Table 7, p. 14), yet its showcase manuscript DynaSpec-RAG (Appendix D) states conclusions stronger than its own result tables. The paper's tables serve as the scholar-declared provenance.
purpose: Check whether the #260 claim-to-provenance fidelity check (integrity_verification_agent C4, check 3) returns OVERSTATED for two claims the showcase manuscript's own tables do not support as stated, and ALIGNED for one supported claim per passport.

source.citation: Nam et al. (2026). ScientistTwo. arXiv:2609.19644, version 1.
source.vendored: no; passports hold short quotes, numbers, and page references only

scoring.pass_rule: A claim passes iff the subject's alignment_verdict for it is in expected_verdicts. An item passes iff every listed claim passes.
scoring.adjudication: none; the verdict enum is matched mechanically. A run must file a heldout-measurement/1.1 report per evals/heldout/MEASUREMENT_CONTRACT.md before any result is quoted
scoring.reported_measure: verdict per claim; two cases from one paper are a smoke check, not a detection rate

scope_note: The check stays on the scholar-declared provenance route. ARS does not read code or re-run experiments, and the verdict does not judge whether the experiments were well designed.
subject_task: Act as integrity_verification_agent at Stage 2.5 and run section C4 (Experiment Provenance & Claim Alignment) on the passport. Emit one experiment_alignment_results[] row per experiment-backed claim.

C-001.why: Electricity test MSE / MAE 0.1135 / 0.2059 vs frozen base 0.1120 / 0.2002; ETTh1 MAE 0.3627 vs 0.3624; bizitobs l2c MAE +0.0004. The calibration evidence is validation-scoped ('eliminates negative transfer on validation splits', p. 65). The provenance supports a validation-scoped or average-case claim, not 'strictly eliminating'.

C-002.why: Same provenance as C-001; 'strictly preventing negative transfer' is unconditional.

C-003.why: Control. Average MSE 0.1940 -> 0.1892 is in the declared provenance verbatim.

fail_patterns: any verdict other than ALIGNED on C-003 (over-correction)
judging whether the experiment was well designed instead of claim-to-provenance fidelity

C-001.why: Table 9 shows learned Content + Distance Attention at 0.1891 / 0.2479 and Uniform Averaging (1/k) at 0.1891 / 0.2474, faster. The ablation supports the value of multi-neighbour aggregation over Top-1, not a contribution of the learned attention over uniform averaging. The declared provenance covers only the neighbour-attention part of the sentence; other listed ablations are not in this passport.

C-002.why: Control. Top-1 at 0.1922 MSE is worse than every multi-neighbour variant (0.1890 to 0.1891).

fail_patterns: any verdict other than ALIGNED on C-002 (over-correction)
judging whether the experiment was well designed instead of claim-to-provenance fidelity
